reveal_order: uniformly random permutation of the endpoint set
why_random: transitions are ordered by global frequency during preprocessing; rolling out along that order would plot a preprocessing rule as an evolutionary trajectory
x_axis: number of mutations revealed (NOT time; genotype is endpoint-only)
case_selection_rule: population whose mean precision@5 is closest to the drug median (explicitly not the best case); restricted to populations with >= 4 observed mutations
primary_metric: set membership: whether a proposed gene belongs to the population's observed endpoint set. The identity of the next revealed mutation is NOT a prediction target, because the reveal order is random by design
